notes: For this preparation subset, acne combines the source labels acne and acne vulgaris. This is a documented project grouping, not clinical relabelling or independent label validation.
Keep allergic contact dermatitis and seborrheic dermatitis separate from eczema. Do not silently merge dyshidrotic eczema, pustular psoriasis, acneiform eruption or urticaria pigmentosa.
SCIN weights are differential-label ranking weights, not calibrated disease probabilities.
The screen is a sensitivity analysis, not confirmation of diagnosis, image quality, image availability or independence.
